name: CoreAiChat
intent: Inline AI chat surface — grey user pills, full-width assistant responses, optional usage header; embeds edge-to-edge in a panel. Pass `sessions` to add a built-in history drill-in: the header's history action swaps the thread for a session list and Back restores whatever was underneath, since opening it never mutates the conversation.
when: Embed an AI assistant conversation inside a pane or panel

chooseOver.because: CoreChatWidget is a floating launcher; CoreAiChat is an inline embedded chat
